claims.assertion: Mari uses a definition of stupidity as harming oneself and others without apparent reason or personal benefit.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says this is a reference definition, not her own.

claims.assertion: She links foolish actions to ego, overconfidence, and attachment to ideas that people defend personally.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says helping others without personal stability can exhaust the helper, and urges setting limits.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She recommends humility, revising beliefs, and meditation to reduce foolish actions; she calls enlightenment an antidote.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
